sourceGeneration.prompt:
Create one finished, centered geometric brand mark on clean white for an infrastructure tool. Construct exactly two thick opposing right-angle brackets with square ends: an upper-left bracket in deep ink #182B3A and a lower-right bracket in blue #0078D4, offset diagonally around a clear horizontal passage. Use a compact, balanced silhouette, equal stroke weights, simple orthogonal geometry, and broad negative space so the mark can be redrawn as two SVG paths and remain recognizable at 16px. Keep the entire mark inside generous white margins. Flat solid fills only. No lettering, text, words, letters, numbers, shadows, gradients, textures, 3D mockups, additional symbols, Microsoft or Azure logos, copied trademarks, people, mascots, globes, padlocks, clouds, or circuit imagery. Show one mark only, not alternatives, a contact sheet, layout mockup, or presentation slide.

Shared direction: Two thick, opposing right-angle brackets with square ends, offset diagonally around an uninterrupted horizontal passage; consistent stroke weight, orthogonal cuts, and generous open space. The favicon uses only the bracket pair, while illustrations enlarge the same geometry into architectural thresholds..

Palette: Relay Blue #0078D4, Structural Ink #182B3A, Chalk #F3F5F7, Signal Ochre #B88628

Original artwork for azbridge. No text, lettering, numbers, watermarks,
signatures, existing logos, Microsoft/Azure branding, people or faces.
Do not depict locks or VPN shields. Make a single composed artwork,
not a sheet of variations or brand presentation. Use only the direction's
supplied color palette and neutral background; crisp edges and deliberate
negative space. The mark must be simple enough to hand-redraw as SVG.
sourceGeneration.postProcessing: Original PNG retained; WebP review copy quality=88 method=6

strategyGeneration.prompt:
Create a considered, distinctive visual identity for azbridge, an open-source
Rust tool and browser control plane for Azure Relay Hybrid Connections.
It links TCP, UDP, HTTP and Unix socket services using outbound HTTPS,
without VPNs or opening inbound firewall ports. Operators manage workspaces,
Relay connections, forwarding profiles, and enrolled gateways.

Positioning: precise, approachable infrastructure; connections with intent;
straightforward engineering rather than magic or AI hype.
Keep the product name azbridge and descriptor "Relay control plane".
Do not imply Microsoft endorsement or promise absolute security.
Native Fluent blue/neutral UI colors and square controls stay unchanged.
Artwork may use compatible blue/ink/neutral tones plus a restrained accent.
No Microsoft/Azure logos, copied trademarks, people, mascots, words or letters
in generated imagery. No globes, padlocks, neon circuit brains, purple
gradients, generic cloud outlines or gratuitous glassmorphism.

Propose exactly three genuinely different directions, not palette variants:
one reduced architectural/geometric mark, one spatial/isometric system,
one flat editorial/abstract symbol system. Each needs a simple recognizable
mark that could be redrawn in SVG and survive a 16px favicon.
Image prompts must specify one finished composition, NOT a contact sheet,
layout mockup, presentation slide, mood board or multiple logo alternatives.
Hero prompts should be landscape editorial illustrations with abundant
negative space and one focal concept, not a diagram of the actual UI.
Logo prompts should be a centered mark on clean white, no lettering,
no text, no shadows, no 3D mockup. Keep the mark inside generous margins.

Return only a JSON object with these keys:
"directions": an array of exactly 3 objects, each with:
  "id": a short lowercase kebab-case identifier,
  "name": short art-direction name,
  "rationale": two sentences explaining the concept and relevance,
  "motif": the precise visual grammar shared by mark and illustrations,
  "palette": array of 4 objects with "name" and "hex" (#RRGGBB),
  "logo_prompt": a complete standalone image-generation prompt,
  "hero_prompt": a complete standalone image-generation prompt.
"taglines": exactly 10 objects with "text" (2-7 words) and "rationale".
"voice": three concise voice principles.

artwork.prompt:
One finished editorial illustration for azbridge, in the approved Offset Span
identity. Architectural geometry only: thick opposing right-angle brackets,
square ends, orthogonal cuts, consistent proportions, an open passage.
Restrained colors: Relay Blue #0078D4, Structural Ink #182B3A, Chalk #F3F5F7,
and at most one tiny Signal Ochre #B88628 rectangular inset.
Reduced flat architectural forms with only very subtle depth. Crisp edges,
deliberate negative space, no texture, no gradients, no decorative complexity.
No text, letters, words, numbers, UI, arrows, logos, watermarks, signatures,
Microsoft or Azure branding, people, clouds, padlocks, shields or circuit boards.
Do not create a diagram, a mockup, a presentation slide, or a sheet of alternatives.


A landscape composition. Two monumental opposing right-angle thresholds
occupy the right half and frame one open horizontal passage. The left
half is abundant empty background for separately composed product copy.
The structure feels precise, calm and approachable. One tiny ochre inset
marks alignment at the corridor edge. Keep all structures inside generous
margins; no cropping. This is the signature azbridge sign-in illustration.


Light variant. Uniform Chalk #F3F5F7 background, blending smoothly at all
four edges. Shapes use Relay Blue and Structural Ink. No visible frame.
